relationships.subject: CXCL13/CXCR5 signaling
relationships.evidence_quote: The CXCL13/CXCR5 signaling could promote neuropathic pain, astrocytes activation, and NLRP3 inflammasome activation in CPSP model rats by targeting NLRP3.

relationships.subject: CXCL13
relationships.evidence_quote: The production of IL-1β, IL-18, and expression of CXCL13, CXCR5, GFAP, NLRP3, and Caspase-1 p20 were increased in recombinant protein CXCL13-treated primary rat astrocytes in a dose-dependent manner

key_findings: Anti-CXCL13 antibody reduced SMIR-induced allodynia and spinal GFAP, NLRP3, Caspase-1 p20 expression
CXCL13 induced NLRP3 inflammasome activation in primary astrocytes, blocked by INF39
